needUpdatePermission: You need product:update to change this.
discardHint: Edits in this section will be lost.
listDescription: Everything in the catalog, in every state — draft, live and archived.
emptyFilteredHint: Try widening the search, or clear the filters to see everything.
emptyHint: Add the first product to start building the catalog.
deleteDescription: "{title}" and everything attached to it — specs, media, add-ons — are removed. This cannot be undone.
translateDirty: Save or discard your unsaved changes first — generating reloads the tabs.
publishDirty: Save or discard your changes first, then publish.
basicsDescription: Names, descriptions and where this product sits in the catalog.
slugHint: The URL segment on the storefront.
shortDescriptionHint: One line, shown on cards and in search results.
categoryChangeHint: Changing it drops spec values belonging to the old category.
descriptionPanelHint: The long copy on the product page, under “Descrizione”.
descriptionBlocked: Give this product a {language} title and slug on the Basics tab first — the API stores a translation as a whole row, so a {language} description has nowhere to go until then.
descriptionNoSourceTitle: This product has no {language} title yet — save the Basics tab first.
descriptionHint: Headings start at H2 — the product title is the page's only H1. Images and video live on the Media tab.
pricingModeHint: Chosen at creation and permanent. A rental is priced by its packages; a fixed product by its base price.
marketingRateHintBody: Shown as “from €X {per}” under the product title. The packages below are what a customer actually pays; the two need not agree. Empty shows the cheapest package instead.
packagesHintTitle: These are the price. At least one.
packagesHintBody: The duration sets the return date: 3 days from 10 August ends 13 August. Variant modifiers are added once on top, not per day.
packageNone: This product cannot be sold without a package — add one.
packageMinError: A rental product needs at least one package.
specsDescription: Defined by the category. These are what the storefront filters and compares on.
specsNoFurther: The category “{name}” defines no further specifications. Add spec fields to it under Categories.
chipsHintBody1: Chips are the first thing a customer reads on the card and at the top of the product page — “Portata 170 kg”, “Telecomando incluso”. Up to {max}, but three read best: the card gives them one line and crops whatever does not fit.
chipsHintBody2: Keep each under {max} characters and lead with the number or the word that sells it. Leave them empty and the page falls back to the category’s comparable specs.
chipsEmpty: No chips — the card and the product page fall back to comparable specs.
chipsFallback: Blank {language} chips fall back to the {source} text.
chipsOrder: Shown in this order on the card and the product page.
addonsDescription: Optional extras offered alongside the product, in this order.
addonsFixedNotice: This product is sold at a fixed price, so its add-ons can only be fixed-price too — a rental add-on would have nothing to bill against.
mediaDescription: Images become WebP on the server at high quality; SVG is stored as-is. Removed files are cleaned up when you save.
mediaThumbnailHint: The one image used in listings and search
mediaVideoHint: Upload mp4/webm (max 30 MB), or add a link
mediaDocumentsHint: PDF, max 15 MB — the alt text is the visible file label
faqsDescription: Shown on the product page, in this order.
faqsEmpty: No FAQs yet. They answer the questions that would otherwise become emails.
questionsDescription: Answered by the customer at checkout — floor number, lift availability, delivery slot — so the order arrives actionable.
termsDescription: Linked documents appear on the product page and are accepted at checkout, in the order ticked.
newDescription: Just enough to create a draft. The full editor opens next.
newModeWarning: Permanent. A product is sold or rented, and this can never be changed after creation.
newFirstPackageAbout: Why a package is required here
newFirstPackageHintTitle: A rental has no price without one.
newFirstPackageHintBody: Add the rest on the pricing tab after saving.
